known_risks: G8 root cause is inferred (click never reached the submit handler), not proven; both plausible mechanisms are removed; CI at the final head is the check.

Interpretation: 'Continue reading' now also includes unread-status books with saved progress > 0; opening a PDF records page 1/N, so merely opening a PDF counts as started. Explicit statuses (finished/stopped) are never overridden. Owner may prefer a different rule.
EPUB percent is approximate until epub.js locations finish generating (keeps the last stored value meanwhile); exact once generated.
Corrupt sidecars are set aside automatically on first read (bytes preserved, named in the notice); no in-app restore UI.
Reader notices show absolute sidecar paths (local paths only).
ArticleReader (markdown/article, a non-goal) still swallows save errors.
